mainEntity.name: What does a token launch marketing agency actually do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A token launch marketing agency handles the communications strategy around a TGE: narrative positioning, press embargo sequencing, tier-1 media outreach, KOL coordination and regional amplification. The trade-off is that most agencies bill $15K–$45K/month and staff juniors on your account once the pitch is sold. A fractional senior operator runs the same scope for $5K–$12K/month, with the person you hired doing the actual pitching.

mainEntity.name: What does token launch marketing cost in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full-service agency retainers run $15K–$45K/month, funded in part by account-team overhead. A fractional senior operator charges $5K–$12K/month for an ongoing engagement, or a fixed launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks covering narrative, embargo, tier-1 outreach and KOL coordination. KOL fees sit on top: nano-tier $200–$1.5K per post, micro $500–$5K, mid-tier $10K–$30K, macro $25K–$100K and up.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can you place a token launch in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream business where the angle holds: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. APAC regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Coverage follows a real news hook. A token launch without a differentiated angle is a wire release, not a story.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I start token launch PR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Six to eight weeks before your public window is the minimum for building a proper embargo, warming journalist relationships and scheduling KOL waves. Twelve weeks is better if the launch includes a major narrative shift, a new chain announcement or a Middle East or APAC expansion angle. Starting two weeks out means no embargo, no sequencing, and placements that hit after the news cycle has moved on.
